summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for SITEVIA WORKS website:
- Part A: Indian 10-digit WhatsApp phone validation, dual industry/website-type preselection on Inquire click, and persistent Dark/Light mode header toggle with smooth transitions.
- Part B: Site-wide unified subtle motion language (fade + slight upward slide, once-only viewport triggers, staggered card reveals, smooth accordion/wizard/filter transitions, and hide-on-scroll-down header with top progress bar).
- Part C: Rotating circular SVG brand badge near hero CTA and interactive 'With / Without Website' comparison flip demo with typing search bar and animated list reordering.
